I was assuming that if, after a close vote, the many promises made by remain were proven to be false, there would surely be another referendum and an out vote, meaning that to go nuclear this time was premature. but perhaps this was indeed the last chance to escape the federal project, in which case the collective wisdom would have got it right. unlike a general election, however, we are dealing with "foreigners" who most citizens don't really understand culturally. this lack of an "informed" gut I think may fuck with the foundations upon which the soundness of our democratic decisions lie.
